course_description: This course introduces the basic concepts and core principles used to formation of modern computer operating systems. The course aims to cover the skills and explain those concepts and principles that are prospective to endure for future years. , The course introduces the concepts of processes, concurrency, synchronization, scheduling, memory management, and file systems.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Apply common scheduling algorithms and Access memory management
Develop students’ skills and knowledge in operating system implementation, table structure and device input output system
Apply storage management, file, directories and solve storage management problem
Developing student critical thinking through the creation of a design paper for a proposed server solution
Apply the skills in implementing different kinds of OS, and its concept and properties.
